title: Lead Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
===================

Key Responsibilities:

* Conduct Job Hazard Analyses (JHAs) and risk assessments for gas turbine components repair processes, identifying risks such as exposure to heavy mechanical lifting, hazardous chemicals (e.g., solvents, coatings), ergonomic hazards, and physical hazards (e.g., noise, heat stress, and sharp edges).
* Lead the full cycle of Industrial Hygiene (IH) management: anticipating, recognizing, evaluating, and controlling of workplace health risks. Conduct detailed exposure assessments (including chemical, biological, physical, and ergonomic stressors) using methods like air sampling, noise monitoring, and ventilation evaluations to ensure compliance with local regulatory, OSHA, ISO 45001, and other relevant global standards.
* Support, implement, and maintain EHS programs, policies, and training specific to repair operations, including GE Vernova EHS Frameworks (eg. lockout/tagout (LOTO), confined space entry), personal protective equipment (PPE) usage, and safe handling of hazardous materials.
* Ensure compliance with Singapore regulations, industry standards and company requirements, by conducting regular audits and inspections of repair shop activities.
* Lead incident investigations for EHS events (e.g., chemical spills, near-misses, or injuries), utilizing root cause analysis tools (e.g., 5-Why, Fishbone) to develop corrective and preventive actions.
* Collaborate with repair teams to integrate EHS considerations into processes such as heavy duty rotor repair, thermal spray coating, laser welding, and non-destructive testing (NDT), ensuring safe equipment operation and material handling.
* Monitor environmental impacts of repair operations, including VOC emissions from coatings and waste from chemical cleaning, and drive sustainability initiatives like waste minimization and recycling of scrap materials.
* Maintain accurate EHS documentation, including safety data sheets (SDSs), waste manifests, and compliance reports, leveraging digital tools to track metrics like incident rates and training completion.
* Provide hands-on training and toolbox talks to repair technicians on topics like safe chemical handling, dust control, and proper use of ventilation systems.
* Support facility leadership in achieving EHS KPIs, such as reducing Total Recordable Incident Rate (TRIR) and improving environmental performance metrics.
* Participate in supplier audits and equipment commissioning to ensure EHS compliance for new tools or chemicals introduced into the repair process.

Qualifications /Requirements:

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Environmental Health & Safety, Industrial Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related field from an accredited institution.
* Minimum of 5 years of EHS experience in manufacturing, industrial repair, or heavy industrial environments, with exposure to processes involving hazardous materials or precision machining.
* Strong knowledge of Singapore Workplace Safety & Health Regulations, Environmental Protection and Management Regulations and OSHA.
* Proficiency in EHS management systems and risk assessment methodologies (e.g., HAZOP, JHA).
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to engage diverse teams and deliver effective training.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced repair environment, with occasional overtime or weekend support as needed.

Desired Characteristics

* Certified Safety Professional (CSP) or equivalent certification.
* Degree, diploma in a relevant field like engineering, environmental and occupational health safety.
* Experience in turbine blade repair, aerospace, or power generation industries, with familiarity in processes like abrasive blasting, thermal spray, or NDT.
* Knowledge of GE Vernova’s EHS systems or similar frameworks in a global manufacturing setting.
* Experience with lean/six sigma tools for process optimization and EHS performance improvement.

**Additional Information**
==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** No

Today, we’re on a journey of transformation. Leveraging technology and creativity to become a future-ready learning organisation. But for all that change, our strategic ambition is consistently clear and bold, which is to be Asia’s leading financial services partner for a sustainable future.

We invite you to build the bank of the future. Innovate the way we deliver financial services. Work in friendly, supportive teams. Build lasting value in your community. Be part of the team driving sustainability and responsible financing across Global Wholesale Banking. You’ll thrive in this role if you’re passionate about sustainability, curious about how finance can drive positive environmental and social outcomes, and comfortable working with research, data, and presentations. You’re proactive, organised, and able to communicate ideas clearly through written materials and decks. **Who you work with**

You’ll be part of the **GWB Sustainability Office** within **Global Corporate Banking** , working closely with relationship teams, risk partners, and other sustainability stakeholders across the Bank. The team collaborates across functions to embed sustainability into business strategies, client solutions, and operational practices.

**Who you are**

* An **Undergraduate or Postgraduate student** with a strong interest in sustainability and sustainable finance
* Curious about ESG topics, climate transition, and responsible banking
* Proficient in **Microsoft Office** , with a strong foundation in preparing presentation decks
* Comfortable with basic analysis and clear, structured writing
* Organised, proactive, and able to work well with diverse stakeholders

This internship will provide you with:

* Exposure to **sustainability principles, regulations, and sustainable financing products**

* Understanding of the Bank’s **Net Zero targets** and how **financed emissions** are computed

Competitive base salary. A suite of holistic, flexible benefits to suit every lifestyle. Community initiatives. Industry-leading learning and professional development opportunities. Your wellbeing, growth and aspirations are every bit as cared for as the needs of our customers.

description:
The Climate Transformation Programme (CTP) aims to develop, inspire and accelerate knowledge-based solutions and educate future leaders to establish the stable climate and environment necessary for resilient, just, and sustainable Southeast Asian societies.

CTP will generate knowledge and innovation across disciplines including climate and Earth science, ecology, materials science, artificial intelligence, humanities, social sciences and the arts, finance, health, and engineering. It will also translate state-of-the-art scientific results into real world solutions for Singapore, and it will transfer these solutions to Southeast Asia (SEA) and beyond.

As part of this programme, Research Cluster 4: Novel engineering solutions for climate impacts, will explore engineering solutions to adapt to sea-level rise and climate-constrained water resources. The CTP research programme is summarised here: https://earthobservatory.sg/research/climate/climate-transformation-programme>.

The Research Associate will be based in School of Civil and Environmental Engineering (CEE) and will be expected to work effectively for advancing the engineering solutions to mitigate the climate change impact which focuses on new design concepts for seawalls and coastal defence systems. The position is expected to perform independent and collaborative research to meet the project objectives, to assist the management work of the project daily operation to facilitate the success of the project.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Conduct research on laboratory experiments to test the performance of flexible seawall in flume test.
* Keep track of the latest related research developments
* Writing project progress reports
* Assist in the daily project operation management.

**Job Requirements:**

* Master’s degree in civil engineering, coastal engineering or related field
* At least 2 years of relevant experience in biogeotechnics
* Familiarity with coastal protection scope
* Expertise in laboratory soil mechanics testing
* Knowledge in ground improvement, coastal erosion and management, hydrodynamics
* Good written and oral communication skills
* Proficiency in oral and written English - essential for data analysis and communication with stakeholders
* Publication track record is an advantage
